name: Upland Software, Inc.

shortInterest.note: Post-split figure, 2.1 days to cover. An older PRE-split figure (842,712 shares, 2026-03-13) is not comparable — the apparent '87% decline' in shares short is largely or entirely a split artifact, not real short-covering.

pe.note: negative earnings — Q2 2026 GAAP net loss of $35.3M (vs $13.0M loss a year earlier), driven mainly by a non-cash goodwill impairment recorded in June 2026.

eps.note: Non-GAAP/adjusted EPS $1.78 vs $1.55 a year earlier; one consensus figure of $1.51 appears to be an estimate, not the actual.

revenue.note: Mainly attributed to 2025 divestitures/sunset assets. Subscription & support revenue $46.2M, down 9% YoY (from $50.5M). Non-GAAP net income $6.6M, +18% YoY; adj. EBITDA margin steady at 26% of revenue. FY2026 guidance: revenue $190.1M-$196.1M; Q3 2026 guidance $45.7M-$48.7M.

growth.note: Company attributes the decline mainly to 2025 divestitures. Adjusted EBITDA was $12.8M (26% margin) vs $13.6M (25%) a year earlier. Q3 2026 guidance: $45.7-48.7M revenue; FY2026 guidance: $190.1-196.1M revenue.

nextEarnings.note: Earnings Whispers estimate (before market open); other aggregators show stale placeholder dates (Jul 30, Apr 30, 2026) that have already passed and are not reliable. Prior pass's conflicting Nov 5/Nov 6 estimates persist across other sources.

fundamentals.REVERSE_SPLIT_NOTE: Upland executed a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, effective 2026-06-17 (charter amendment filed 2026-06-03), to regain Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance. Pre-split share count was ~29.4M; post-split ~2.9M. All post-6/17/2026 share counts below are POST-split; pre-split figures seen on some aggregator pages are stale/non-comparable.

price.note: Dated snapshots conflict: $5.07 (2026-08-07/08-10, Upstox, paired with an implausible $144.94M market-cap figure likely mixing pre-split ~29.4M share count with a post-split price) vs. $3.94 (2026-09-18, Value Research). No reliable figure for 2026-10-23 found.

catalysts.headline: Carahsoft named Master Government Aggregator for Upland's knowledge-management/contact-center software, distributed via NASA SEWP V and NASPO ValuePoint contract vehicles
catalysts.note: Existence of a Carahsoft/Upland government-aggregator relationship was corroborated in search results as recent news, but the exact 2026-09-16 date was not independently re-confirmed via a dated primary source in this session; carried over from prior snapshot.

catalysts.headline: Announced a partnership naming Carahsoft as its Master Government Aggregator, distributing Upland's knowledge-management/contact-center software to public-sector buyers via NASA SEWP V, NASPO ValuePoint and other cooperative contracts
Q2 2026 results: revenue $49.1M (-8% YoY); GAAP net loss $35.3M (incl. ~$35.2M goodwill impairment); non-GAAP net income $6.6M (+18% YoY); cash on hand $31.0M; operating cash flow $5.4M
catalysts.source: Company press release (via 01net.it / financialcontent.com mirrors of BusinessWire)

catalysts.headline: Received Nasdaq notice of falling below the $15M minimum market value of publicly held shares requirement; 180-day cure period to 2027-01-27
catalysts.source: SEC 8-K (per WebSearch summary of filing text)

catalysts.headline: Nasdaq confirmed the minimum-bid-price noncompliance matter was closed (closing bid price had been >= $1.00 for the prior 10 consecutive business days as of 2026-07-02)
catalysts.source: SEC 8-K / Barchart republication of company press release

catalysts.headline: 1-for-10 reverse stock split became effective at 12:01 AM ET, reducing shares outstanding from ~29.4M to ~2.9M
catalysts.source: Company 10-Q (per WebSearch summary); board approved the ratio 2026-06-04

conflicts: Carahsoft 'Master Government Aggregator' item: this session found the Carahsoft announcement itself (and syndicated pickups) dated 2026-08-17 ('Upland Software and Carahsoft Partner to Expand Public Sector Impact'), covering the same NASA SEWP V / NASPO ValuePoint contract-vehicle distribution described in the baseline. This is a DIFFERENT date than the on-file 2026-09-16 date, and no 2026-09-16-dated source for this item was found. Recommend treating 2026-08-17 as the better-supported date unless a 9/16 primary source turns up.
Next earnings date: on-file 2026-11-13 estimate (Earnings Whispers) still not confirmed directly by a company press release.
notes: The reverse split (confirmed this pass, 1-for-10 effective 2026-06-17) is the dominant fact for UPLD's fundamentals this period — it invalidates most pre-June-2026 share-count, market-cap, and short-interest figures found in generic aggregator searches. No clearly-dated substantive news found strictly after 2026-09-16/08-17.
